title: Withholding from Retroactive Disability Compensation Payments
content:
**Fee withholding.** From every retroactive Disability Compensation payment, the fee-withholding percentage of the past-due amount is withheld for direct payment of the representative's fee when a direct-pay fee agreement is on file, and nothing is withheld otherwise. Past-due amounts created only by adding dependents or by releasing suspended months are not subject to fee withholding. The fee withheld is the gross past-due amount multiplied by the fee-withholding percentage, rounded to the cent.

**Debt offset.** When the veteran has a VA benefit debt in active collection, the remaining amount is applied to that debt before any release, under the debt offset rules, and only the balance is paid.

**Net release.** The amount released is the gross past-due amount less the fee withheld and less the amount applied to the debt.

**Second signature.** A retroactive payment whose gross amount is the second-signature threshold or more requires a second signature before release.

**Worked example (hypothetical, with the 20 percent fee rate and the 25000.00 threshold).** A favorable decision creates past-due benefits of 9876.55; a direct-pay fee agreement is on file and a VA debt of 500.00 is in active collection.

| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| Gross past-due | 9876.55 |
| Fee withheld: 9876.55 multiplied by 20 percent, rounded to the cent | 1975.31 |
| Applied to the debt | 500.00 |
| Released to the veteran | 7401.24 |
| Second signature | Not required (below 25000.00) |

**Contrasting cases (hypothetical)**

| Origin of the past-due amount | Fee agreement on file | Fee withheld |
|---|---|---|
| Favorable rating decision | Yes | 20 percent of the past-due |
| Favorable rating decision | No | Nothing |
| Adding dependents only | Yes | Nothing |
| Release of suspended months | Yes | Nothing |
